title: observability-token-kv-logging-metrics-dashboard-alert-tuning-extended
author: Claire Liu
body: Context: Production metrics for token-level cost/latency and KV cache telemetry were fragmented across multiple dashboards and logging formats which made incident triage slow and SLO tuning error-prone. Motivation: Provide a single, queryable metric set and unified Grafana dashboard with improved tracing spans and log enrichment so oncall and SRE can quickly attribute cost and latency regressions to model variants, request paths, or KV cache behavior. Changes: 1) Metrics: introduce new Prometheus metrics: redwood_inference_token_cost_usd_total (labels: model, variant, deployment_tier), redwood_inference_token_latency_ms_bucket (histogram with endpoint/request_type labels), redwood_kv_cache_hit_ratio (gauge by model/instance, exported from runtime), redwood_kv_cache_evictions_total. These are instrumented in serving/runtime and the routing layer. 2) Tracing: add span annotations for kv.cache.hit, kv.cache.miss, kv.cache.eviction and propagate model_variant and route metadata into top-level traces. 3) Logging: standardize structured request logs (JSON) to include request_id, user_id_hash, model, variant, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, kv_hits, kv_miss_count and cost_usd. 4) Dashboards: new Grafana dashboard "Inference Token-level Cost & KV Behavior" with panels for per-model token cost, latency p50/p95/p99 by route, KV hit ratio heatmap, and a correlated logs/trace panel for slow requests. 5) Alerts: tuned alert rules and runbooks: set token-cost regression alert to trigger on >15% sustained increase in redwood_inference_token_cost_usd_total over 30m with accompanying increase in latency, add KV-cache-degradation alert when kv_cache_hit_ratio drops below 0.75 for 10m or evictions spike >300/min, and add a meta-alert if large model variant rollouts increase cost or tail latency. 6) Backwards compatibility: old metrics are preserved for 30 days and a migration guide for dashboards included. Migration: rolled out metric exports behind a feature flag (observability.token_kv_v2). Rollout plan: enable in staging -> Canary (10% traffic) -> 100% over 6 hours with automated rollback if p99 latency increases by >10% or error rate spikes. Testing: unit tests for metric instrumentation, integration tests validating Prometheus scrape format, end-to-end smoke tests on staging with load generator to validate KV metrics under load. Documentation: updated runbook and Grafana dashboard JSON export + README with example queries. Risks: minimal runtime overhead measured at <1.2% CPU on representative instances; addressed with sampling and batching of metric exports. Related: SUP-1129 (customer report of missing kv metrics), ENG-4532 dashboard consolidation, ENG-4601 alert tuning. Checklist: shipped metrics, tracing, logging, dashboards exported, alerts created, runbooks updated, docs added.

review_comments: Diego Ramirez: Can we confirm cardinality of labels on redwood_inference_token_cost_usd_total? model+variant+route may be high; suggest collapsing route to coarse path.
Claire Liu: Addressed by adding 'route_group' label instead of raw route; added aggregation examples in docs.
Aisha Khan: Alert thresholds look reasonable; please add a short delay for KV eviction spikes to avoid noisy alerts during restarts.
Claire Liu: Added 2 minute suppression window and a rate check to inference_token_evictions_total to avoid alerts during rolling restarts.
Benji Morales: CI failed once due to prom scrape test flakiness; added retry with exponential backoff.
release_notes: Added token-level cost and latency metrics, KV cache telemetry, unified Grafana dashboard, and tuned alerts/runbooks to improve triage and cost visibility.
